title: An Odyssey to Sri Lanka
highlights: Witness the majestic elephants in their natural habitat, offering a heartwarming experience of rehabilitation and care at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
Immerse yourself in the vibrant rhythms and traditional dances of Kandy, showcasing the island's rich cultural heritage
Encounter spiritual serenity at the Temple of Tooth Relic, housing the revered Buddha Tooth Relic amidst intricate architecture and religious rituals
Stand in awe of nature's beauty as you witness the cascading Ramboda Falls, a breathtaking waterfall surrounded by lush greenery
Play a role in sea turtle conservation by visiting a Turtle Hatchery, where you can witness the incredible journey from egg to hatchling, contributing to the preservation of these endangered species
overview:
About the tour:
Embark on an enchanting journey through the heart of Sri Lanka with this 8-day tour package. Begin your adventure at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, witnessing the majesty of rescued elephants. Immerse yourself in Kandy's cultural tapestry with visits to Kandy Lake, the Bahiravokanda Vihara Buddha Statue, and the mesmerizing Kandyan Dance performance. Explore the art of tea-making at a plantation and factory, then pay homage to the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple.
Continue to Nuwara Eliya, where the scenic landscapes unfold with stops at the Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls, Gregory Lake, and the Hakgala Botanical Gardens. Discover Bentota's coastal wonders with a serene Madhu River boat ride, a visit to Turtle Hatchery, and the unique experience of a Cinnamon Plantation and Fish Pedicure Centre.
Finally, conclude your odyssey in Colombo, exploring the historic Fort and Pettah districts and ascending the iconic Lotus Tower. This meticulously curated package ensures you discover the diverse wonders of Sri Lanka, blending cultural richness, natural beauty, and unforgettable experiences.

All entry tickets for attractions, state and entry fees, boat rides, camera charges,etc. are not a part of the package.
Early check in & late checkout prices are not a part of the package.

All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package. (Please visit www.eta.gov.lk for more details / submit your individual visa application)
The above rates would vary and won't be the same on special days such as Diwali, Dussehra, Christmas and New Years.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.

Rates may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests, hotel change, etc., before the beginning of the trip.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy | Explore the life of Sri Lankan Elephants in Pinnawala
days.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, the representative will take you to Kandy. En route, stop by the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, which offers a nurturing environment for rescued elephants. Proceed to Kandy, check-in at the hotel, and take a moment to unwind. In the evening, enjoy the town's scenic vistas from Upper Lake Drive and experience the captivating Kandyan Dance performance. Following your exploration, get transferred back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour | Explore the Jewels of the city
days.desc: After breakfast, meet the representative, who will take you on a sightseeing tour of the city. Start with the ascend to Bahiravokanda Vihara and be awed by the colossal Buddha Statue offering panoramic views of Kandy. Next, visit a Tea Plantation and a Tea Factory and get to know about the production process. Afterwards, continue towards the Temple of Tooth Relic which houses the relic of the tooth of Buddha and then visit Huluganga Waterfall. After the tour, get transferred to the hotel.

items.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Start with the ascend to Bahiravokanda Vihara for a serene encounter with the towering Buddha Statue overlooking Kandy.
Enjoy panoramic views of the city, marvel at the intricate details, and embrace the tranquillity of this sacred site.
Next, visit the Tea Plantation and factory and witness the tea cultivation process, from plucking to processing, and learn about the various types of tea produced.
Tour the tea factory, observing the machinery and equipment used in the production of Sri Lanka's renowned Ceylon tea
Next, head towards the iconic Temple of the Tooth Relic & explore the temple complex, housing the sacred tooth relic of Lord Buddha.
In the end, head towards Huluganga waterfall, surrounded by lush greenery & take a refreshing dip or simply enjoy the stunning natural beauty of the waterfall and its surroundings.

days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to Nuwara Eliya. Once you arrive, get transferred to the hotel and proceed with the check-in formalities. After a while, get ready to explore the city. Start with a visit to a tea plantation and then continue towards the historic Hanuman Temple, believed to be Hanuman's first landing site on the quest for Goddess Sita. At the end, visit Ramboda Falls & Gregory Lake. Afterwards, return to the hotel.

items.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Start the tour by visiting a tea plantation for an immersive experience. Learn about the tea-making process, from cultivation to processing.
Next, explore the Hanuman Temple, believed to be the first place where Hanuman landed in his quest for Goddess Sita. Absorb the spiritual ambience and enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings.
Continue with the visit to the magnificent Ramboda Falls, the eleventh-tallest waterfall in Sri Lanka. Marvel at the 109-meter-high cascade and capture breathtaking photos of the natural beauty that surrounds it.
Head to Gregory Lake, a serene reservoir surrounded by lush landscapes where you can enjoy boating amidst the tranquil surroundings. (Additional cost)

days.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour | Explore the Jewels of the City
days.desc: After breakfast, meet the representative, who will take you on a sightseeing tour. Start with a journey to Hakgala Botanical Gardens, a haven for diverse wildlife, featuring bears, monkeys, and vibrant bird species. Continue the tour to the Seetha Amman Temple, built where Seeta Mata endured captivity in Ravana's prison. Afterwards, immerse yourself in the lush surroundings of Victoria Park, adorned with floral beauty. After the tour, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you on a sightseeing tour.
After the tour, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Start the tour with Hakgala Botanical Gardens, renowned for its stunning flora and fauna. Explore the diverse plant collections and encounter wildlife, including bears, monkeys, and various bird species.
Visit the Seetha Amman Temple, situated at the location where Seeta Mata, from the Hindu epic Ramayana, spent her days in Ravana's prison. Explore the temple's spiritual significance and the surrounding lush landscapes.
Head to Victoria Park & take a stroll through well-manicured lawns, vibrant flower beds and enjoy the serene ambiance.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Bentota | To the city of Golden Beaches
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to Bentota, the city of Golden Beaches. Once you arrive, get transferred to the hotel and proceed with the check-in formalities. In the evening, get transferred to Madhu River where you can enjoy a boat ride amidst the tranquil environment. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Nuwara Eliya and take you to the hotel in Bentota.
In the evening, get transferred to the Madhu River.
Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Leisurely Evening at Madu River
items.desc:
Indulge in a leisurely evening at the Madu River, an idyllic destination offering a tranquil escape.
You can hop on a boat and embark on a serene journey along the river, surrounded by lush mangroves and the soothing sounds of nature. 
As the sun sets, the riverbanks come alive with the warm hues of twilight, creating a picturesque backdrop for a peaceful and immersive experience.

days.title: Sightseeing in Bentota | Explore the major attractions
days.desc: After breakfast, meet the representative who will take you on a sightseeing tour. Start by visiting Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, the prime turtle nesting site. Afterwards, explore Cinnamon Plantation, where the fragrant spice unfolds its cultivation secrets. Then, indulge in an unconventional treat at the Fish Pedicure Centre, letting tiny fish create a soothing spa experience. After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you on a sightseeing tour.
After exploration, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Head towards Kosgoda to visit the Turtle Hatchery. Witness the remarkable process of nurturing newborn turtle hatchlings in large tanks.
Learn about the conservation efforts and see how these baby turtles are fed before being released into the sea after 2-4 days.
Continue your journey to a Cinnamon Plantation. Explore the plantation and learn about the cultivation and processing of this aromatic spice. Engage your senses in the fragrant world of cinnamon.
Visit the Fish Pedicure Centre for a unique wellness experience. Let tiny fish gently exfoliate your feet, creating a relaxing and unconventional spa sensation.

days.title: Bentota - Colombo | Drive to Sri Lanka's Prime City
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to Colombo, the capital city of Sri Lanka. Once you arrive at the hotel in Colombo, check-in and relax for a while. Afterwards, get transferred to witness the historical, religious and commercial sites of Colombo including Fort & Pettah. Witness other attractions like Lotus Tower, Lover’s Island, and more. In the evening, you can stroll on the shopping streets. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Bentota and transfer you to the hotel in Colombo.
Once you get settled in, get picked up from the hotel in Colombo for the city exploration.
Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing
items.desc:
Start at the historic Fort area, walking through its colonial remnants, including the Old Parliament and Dutch Hospital.
Explore Pettah's bustling market, known for its vibrant streets, diverse shops, and the Red Mosque.
Head to the iconic Lotus Tower, Sri Lanka's tallest tower where you can also enjoy panoramic views of Colombo from its observation deck.
Visit the rooftop Sky Lounge for a relaxing break with cityscape views.
Head to Galle Face Green, a popular seaside promenade. Enjoy a stroll, witness the sunset, and engage in local street food delights.

days.title: Departure | Take a bag full of memories
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to the airport to board a flight back home. Take a bag full of memories to cherish for eternity.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to the airport to catch a flight back home.
